Apollo Pharmacy
sells and distributes over 70,000 products
, featuring an extensive catalog of
top domestic and international pharmaceutical manufacturers, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) corporations, and its own proprietary private-label brands
Apollo Pharmacy
Private Label Brands
Apollo Pharmacy markets over 400 of its own signature and value-driven products manufactured via contract partners, which include:
Apollo Pharmacy
Apollo Life / Apollo Essentials / Apollo Pharmacy:
Encompassing everyday health supplements, vitamins, cotton buds, toothbrushes, mouthwashes, hand sanitizers, wet wipes, and adult diapers.
B +ve:
Skincare and personal care items like face washes, body washes, glycerin soaps, moisturizers, sunscreens, and lip balms.
Baby Best:
Specialized pediatric and baby care items.
Doctor Choice:
Healthcare lifestyle products including hot/cold gel packs and cotton crepe bandages.
Apollo Pharmacy
Major Pharmaceutical Manufacturers
The inventory includes mainstream prescription drugs, injectables, and over-the-counter therapeutics sourced from top pharmaceutical companies such as:
Abbott India, Cipla, Mankind Pharma, Alkem Laboratories
Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Intas Pharmaceuticals, Macleods Pharmaceuticals
Alembic Pharmaceuticals, Aurobindo Pharma, Ajanta Pharma, Biocon
Apollo Pharmacy
Wellness, FMCG, and OTC Brands
Consumer wellness, nutrition, and personal care shelves feature prominent third-party labels including:
Ayurvedic & Herbal:
Patanjali, Himalaya, Zandu, Baidyanath, Dabur
Personal & Skin Care:
Cetaphil, Neutrogena, Sebamed, Biotique, L'Oreal, Dettol
Nutrition & Health Food:
Nestlé, Protinex, Horlicks, Revital, Yogabar
Apollo Pharmacy
